caption: The drawing depicts a single hand drill brace, rendered in shades of brown to represent a wooden texture. The object is shown vertically, and the brace consists of a central, curved “S”-shaped arm with a cylindrical handle at the top and a cylindrical fitting at the bottom, where a tool would be inserted. The surface displays darker shading on the curves and edges to suggest depth and three-dimensionality. The lines and curves of the wood grain have been carefully illustrated. The background is plain and off-white, allowing the drill brace to be the central focus. The artist’s signature, “Frank H. Gray,” is written in small letters near the bottom right of the image. There are no other objects present in the composition.
title: Carpenter's Brace
